metas.name: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
metas.description:
Captures a ship as a complete working system. During the Napoleonic Wars a British frigate hunts a French ship around South America — seamanship, weather and hierarchy, and a captain whose naturalist friend would rather be cataloguing species in the Galápagos.

During the Napoleonic Wars, a brash British captain pushes his ship and crew to their limits in pursuit of a formidable French war vessel around South America.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description:
Captures momentum as a physical state. Almost no dialogue, one chase out and one chase back — speed, heat and desperation, with a war-rig as a whole society in miniature.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Harakiri
metas.description:
Captures an honour code as bureaucratic cruelty. A penniless samurai asks to die at a clan house; the story he tells, and the one they tell back, dismantle the whole code — a courtroom film with swords.

When a ronin requesting seppuku at a feudal lord's palace is told of the brutal suicide of another ronin who previously visited, he reveals how their pasts are intertwined - and in doing so challenges the clan's integrity.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
metas.description:
Captures what a comic book actually feels like to read, in motion. Also a genuinely good story about a kid learning that anyone can wear the mask, by failing at it a lot.

Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description:
Captures professionalism as a whole identity, on both sides of the law. A robber and a detective each incapable of a life outside the work, recognising themselves in each other over coffee.

A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: Thief
metas.description:
Captures a craftsman trying to buy a normal life with one last job. A Chicago safecracker with a collage of his dream life in his wallet, neon and rain, tools on metal filmed like jewellery-making.

After years in prison, ace safe-cracker Frank owns a car dealership and a cocktail lounge, which are fronts for high-stakes jewelry heists. He wants to complete one last big heist for the Mob before he goes straight.

metas.name: Princess Mononoke
metas.description:
Captures an ecological war with no pure side. Iron Town needs the forest cut to survive; the forest gods need the humans gone; a prince cursed by a dying god tries to see with unclouded eyes.

After a deadly curse forces him from home, young warrior Ashitaka journeys west and is drawn into a conflict between ancient forest spirits, an iron town, and a wolf-raised girl.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description:
Captures an idealist being used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description:
Captures two brothers robbing the bank that is taking their family's land. West Texas, foreclosed ranches and debt-relief billboards, and two ageing Rangers following them at the speed of talk — a western wearing a recession.

A divorced father and his ex-con brother plan a series of heists against the bank that's about to foreclose on their family ranch.

metas.name: Wolfwalkers
metas.description:
Captures the wild being hunted in the name of order. Kilkenny, 1650: a hunter's daughter befriends a girl who becomes a wolf in her sleep, and Cartoon Saloon's hand-drawn forest keeps breaking out of the town's straight lines.

A young apprentice hunter and her father journey to Ireland to help wipe out the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description:
Captures male friendship at blockbuster maximum. Two revolutionaries, a rescue on a collapsing bridge, a dance-off against the British, a man carrying a leopard into a party — three hours that never once do anything at half scale.

A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description:
Captures a nation with nothing left being asked to fight again. Postwar Japan, a kamikaze pilot who couldn't do it the first time, and a monster film whose human scenes work as well as its spectacle.

A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
metas.description:
Captures conquest as a fever that keeps marching after its purpose has rotted. Herzog takes a conquistador expedition down the Amazon until the jungle, the raft and Klaus Kinski's face are all dissolving at the same rate.

In the 16th century, the ruthless and insane Don Lope de Aguirre leads a Spanish expedition in search of El Dorado.

metas.name: A Touch of Zen
metas.description:
Captures combat choreographed as calligraphy, then dropped entirely for transcendence. King Hu's wuxia epic follows a scholar drawn into a fugitive's fight against the imperial secret police, ascending through a bamboo-forest duel toward something close to enlightenment.

A lady fugitive on the run from corrupt government officials is joined in her endeavors by an unambitious painter and skilled Buddhist monks.

metas.name: Sherlock Jr.
metas.description:
Captures a projectionist climbing into the screen to fix the plot from inside. A century old and still the cleanest film ever made about wanting to live in the observed layer instead of the real one; the montage where the scenery changes around him mid-step has never been topped.

A film projectionist longs to be a detective, and puts his meagre skills to work when he is framed by a rival for stealing his girlfriend's father's pocketwatch.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All at Once
metas.description:
Captures a multiverse used as a family argument. A laundromat owner audits her failed lives across universes — chef, starlet, rock, sausage-fingered pianist — and the loudest sci-fi machinery of the decade is aimed at a tax audit and a daughter. Absent from your 363; its absence was a gap, not a judgement.

A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

metas.name: An Actor's Revenge
metas.description:
Captures kabuki artifice turned into a weapon. An onnagata — a male actor who plays women — hunts the three men who destroyed his parents, never leaving character onstage or off; Ichikawa shoots it in widescreen tableaux where the theatrical sets and the "real" streets obey the same painted logic. Maximalism with a revenge plot for a spine.

Yukinojo, a Kabuki actor, seeks revenge by destroying the three men who caused the deaths of his parents. Also involved are the daughter of one of Yukinojo's targets, two master thieves, and a swordsman who himself is out to kill ...

metas.name: Ghost in the Shell
metas.description:
Captures a cyborg major hunting a hacker who may be the first digital life-form, in long rain-slick silences between the action. The gap in your collection: the film that made "what counts as a self when every layer is replaceable" into mainstream science fiction, and it argues by canal boat and museum tree as much as by dialogue.

A cyborg policewoman and her partner hunt a mysterious and powerful hacker called the Puppet Master.

metas.name: Redline
metas.description:
Captures the most dangerous race in the galaxy, drawn by hand over seven years. A pompadoured driver, a fascist robot planet, cars that deform like taffy at speed; there is no CGI sheen anywhere, just 100,000 drawings insisting that velocity is a drawing problem.

A story about the most popular racing event in the galaxy, the Redline, and the various racers who compete in it.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description:
Captures a boy teaching a fifty-foot weapon that it can choose what it is. Cold War Maine, a beatnik sculptor, a government man terrified of the unknown — and the Giant learning the word for what he refuses to be. Friendship between unequals where the smaller one does the moral teaching; “you are who you choose to be” earned, not printed.

A young boy befriends a giant robot from outer space that a paranoid government agent wants to destroy.
